Thanks — I started a first-pass triage. Notes so far:
- Correlated the trace id in the Finovate log to an internal proxy 502 -> runtime 500 during a prefetch/variant switch.
- Reproduction attempt in our staging shows session termination when the client sends back-to-back streaming requests while a route switch occurs (variant prefetch + connection drain).
- Hypothesis: race between client-side keepalive/stream resubscribe and server-side variant handoff.

Immediate mitigation we can offer today:
1) Pin Finovate's traffic to a compatible variant (no prefetch) for the pilot window — this avoids the routing handoff race.
2) Short-term client-side recommendation: increase keepalive to 90s and implement idempotency token on retries (we can provide example header).

Triage asks for runtime team (Jonas):
- Can you capture server-side connection close reasons for the implicated traces? I put a request on the RUM link and attached the log excerpt.
- If the connection close reason is "variant_drain_timeout" we should file an SLA exception and provide a one-week mitigation plan.

I'll draft a short pilot SLA paragraph once Jonas confirms.

— Logan
Sales Eng Manager

Quick runtime findings after correlating the trace and the demo log:
- Server-side connection closes show "drain_abort" with a 500 back to the client. The sequence aligns with a variant prefetch operation that overlapped an inflight streaming session.
- Repro: running two consecutive streams while triggering a variant update produced the same closed-socket pattern.

Action plan (short horizon):
1) Hotfix / mitigation: we can introduce a short gating window on variant rollouts for pinned customers (config flag: rollout.safe_window=true) — effectively disables prefetch-driven handoffs for that customer. Ops can push this as a customer-level toggle within 2 business days.
2) Observability: I'll add a temporary trace tag and a dashboard tile for "variant_drain_abort" so we can monitor occurrences during the pilot.
3) SLA exception: Based on this, we should offer Finovate a one-week SLA note that we will pin their route + monitor and treat any replication as a SEV for the pilot period. Legal can accept that scope if we keep it timeboxed.

Reqs:
- Marissa: please draft the one-week pilot paragraph and mark it timeboxed to the pilot dates. Include the configuration change (rollout.safe_window=true) and the fallback (route to dedicated variant if repeat failure within 24 hours).
- Avery / Logan: please gather the exact trace ids and the customer repro window (timestamps) so I can surface them to infra if we need a fast patch.

Adding the log excerpt I used and a quick screenshot to the ticket.

— Jonas

Hi Olivia — quick update and short pilot note that you can share with SecOps: 

Summary of what we found:
- Root cause: variant handoff during concurrent streaming sessions triggered a server-side drain that surfaced as a 500 to the client. We reproduced the issue in staging.
- Immediate mitigation: Redwood will pin Finovate's demo route to a compatible variant and enable rollout.safe_window=true for the duration of the pilot. That removes the prefetch-driven handoff window.

Pilot SLA paragraph (timeboxed):
"For the one-week pilot window (May 3–May 10, 2027), Redwood Inference will: (a) pin traffic for the specified demo route to a compatible serving variant; (b) enable a safe rollout gating configuration to prevent prefetch-driven handoffs (rollout.safe_window=true); and (c) monitor related trace metrics and treat any repeated occurrences as a priority incident with a committed 4-hour response time during the pilot. This scope is limited to the pilot route and timeframe and does not modify Redwood's standard production SLAs outside the pilot window."

Attachments: I attached the log excerpt we used and a short note describing the rollout.safe_window toggle. If SecOps needs any additional language for indemnity or data handling, let us know and we can loop Legal.

Next steps:
- We will schedule a 30-min joint run with your staging team on Tue May 4 to validate the pinned deployment.
- Jonas will enable the temporary observability tile and share access.

Thanks — aiming to get you unblocked for the pilot sign-off.
